## Summary

Describe the user or operational outcome and the implementation.

## Risk

- [ ] Authentication or authorization
- [ ] Credits, pricing, payments, or ledger
- [ ] Provider submission or reconciliation
- [ ] Database migration
- [ ] Customer media or personal data
- [ ] No elevated-risk area

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting passes
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Type-check passes
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Build passes
- [ ] New environment variables are documented
- [ ] Database changes include a reviewed migration
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for UI changes
